figures.Fig14.4: Formation of urine. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch14-fig-urine-formation (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book places tubular secretion in the distal convoluted tubule only; secretion also occurs in the proximal tubule (e.g. penicillin) and the collecting duct. The lesson notes this, flagged.
The side boxes on osmoregulation and on hot weather are carried in the lesson.
